validity: This beta score is computed by code from the repo's own files with fixed, published weights: it is reproducible and says which conventions the repo already keeps, not how good its design is, and it is not a benchmark against other teams.
limits: Weights, targets and band edges are published conventions, not fitted to any set of repos; they will change once goldens exist across more repos.
The score reads files and code patterns, not the product: a repo can keep every counted convention and still look inconsistent, and the reverse.
Drift is counted per 100 UI files, so adding UI files without styling lowers the drift penalty.
Rationale counts the decisions, goals and cited learnings that exist; it does not judge whether they are right.
When an input cannot be computed it is left out and the other weights of its dimension are rescaled; when coverage falls below 0.8 the score is withheld.
